verdict.rationale: Honeybadger explicitly supports un-minifying JS via a documented Source Map Upload API (honeybadger-docs-16), and it has a general CLI (honeybadger-docs-18) suited to CI usage, but the evidence never shows a dedicated CLI subcommand or an official bundler plugin (webpack/vite/rollup) specifically for uploading source maps from CI. missing for 10: explicit CLI source-map subcommand documentation, official bundler plugin integration, and a CI usage example showing symbolized production stack traces.
